added: Memos can repeat on chosen days of the week: the edit sheet has a Repeat toggle, S M T W T F S day cells and Weekdays / Weekends / Every day shortcuts, and a Next ring banner shows when it will go off
changed: The memo sheet now uses the same layout as the chore and task sheets: the title is the input, the time is a large serif value, and Archive and Delete are centred links under Cancel and Save
Unsaved memo edits survive rotation and process death and are offered back when the sheet is reopened, like chore and task edits
